abilities.name: Ginga Style
abilities.condition: Opponent in front, originally three charges within 10s

abilities.name: Butterfly Counter
abilities.condition: Counter if tackled or stolen from during scissors

abilities.name: Butterfly Dance
abilities.condition: Restricted to opponent goalbox (C named in September 13 announcement).

facts.title: Lavinho balance
facts.text: Ginga Shot distance −15%, cooldown 40s → 47.5s and one dash removed. Rising Dance/Butterfly combo cooldown 35s → 45s; Butterfly Counter 30s → 35s.

facts.title: August balance
facts.text: Ginga Shot distance −15%, CD 40s → 47.5s, one dash removed; Rising Dance/Butterfly CD 35s → 45s; Butterfly Counter 30s → 35s. Repeated September 19.

facts.title: Bachira–Lavinho chemistry
facts.text: Announced added; author was unsure whether it was the NEL Bachira version.

facts.title: September balance
facts.text: Ginga Shot −10%; all three Ginga Style charges gain i-frames; Butterfly Dribble faster; Butterfly Dance restricted to opponent goalbox.

facts.title: Butterfly Dance pending at release
facts.text: The release announcement marked Butterfly Dance (C) as coming later that day; September 20 balance notes subsequently describe its goalbox restriction.

history.title: September quality of life
history.text: Watchtower added to Niko. Barou received aim and dribble adjustments; Loki and Lavinho were balanced. One goal counted as 1 MVP point and one save as 0.75. Per-style awakening outfits and party improvements arrived; summer map removed.

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: Mobile controls and fixes
history.text: Movable mobile buttons and new loading screen; shot and steal-cutscene bug fixes. King moved to Legendary; Yukimiya temporarily moved to Legendary before the May 23 reversal.

history.title: Reo copy and mastery toggles
history.text: Reo Copy re-enabled and buffed. NEL mastery toggles and Bachira–Lavinho chemistry announced, with kit variant uncertain in source.

history.title: Bachira and NEL Bachira rework
history.text: Both kits revised, NEL questline system and NEL Bachira–Lavinho chemistry announced.

history.title: Rebalance bug fixes
history.text: Fixed a wide range of ability bugs including full-field Street Sweep, Bloodlust, NEL Isagi–Kaiser chemistry cooldown and awakening interactions.

history.title: Nagi, Loki and Lavinho balance
history.text: Detailed nerfs and removals for Nagi and McNagi, Loki aerial trap removal, Lavinho balance and flow adjustments.
